instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Titan manages a vast music catalog involving complex international royalty collection and sync licensing across various media formats. The company is grappling with the need to modernize its back-end infrastructure, particularly concerning streaming data ingestion and ensuring compliance with evolving global intellectual property laws. Operations span multiple jurisdictions, requiring sophisticated geo-specific revenue reporting.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is not a formalized function in our organization; initiatives are reactive and sporadic. We occasionally try new tools or workflows when a team member champions them, but these efforts lack structured project management, executive sponsorship, and standardized metrics for success, leading to inconsistent adoption across business units.
answers.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months. We have a 6-9 month window to build competitive moats through technological differentiation, exclusive partnerships, or service-level improvements that would be costly for a new entrant to replicate quickly.
answers.additionalContext: Upcoming changes to industry-specific safety and certification standards will require us to recertify our entire product line over the next 2 years. The recertification process is expensive and time-consuming; we need innovation ideas that either accelerate the workflow or deliver sufficient business value to justify the combined investment.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: Automated Royalty Tracking Dashboard
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a centralized dashboard to track streaming royalty streams will improve operational visibility and accuracy for the small leadership team. This incremental improvement reduces manual reconciliation time by an estimated 15%, directly supporting market defense against competitors who might offer superior tracking tools.

first_actions: Select a low-cost, off-the-shelf API solution for data ingestion.
Define and map core royalty metrics (stream counts vs. payout).
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual reconciliation hours by 15% within 6 months.
milestones: Q1: Pilot integration with one major streaming platform.
Q2: Full deployment and reporting across all core business units.

opportunities.title: AI-Assisted Music Similarity Detection Engine (Infringement Monitoring)
opportunities.rationale: Developing an AI engine to proactively identify copyright infringement across global media libraries offers a strong market defense. While high-risk, focused initial development can create a unique technological moat that prevents competitors from easily replicating our deep catalog knowledge.

first_actions: Identify a narrow vertical (e.g., visual similarity detection for film sync).
Secure consultancy expertise to define the minimum viable product (MVP) scope.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 80% false positive reduction in infringement alerts within the first year.
milestones: Q3: MVP prototype completion and internal testing.
Q4: Initial commercial rollout of the detection service.

next_steps.action: Formally establish a cross-functional 'Idea Validation' committee for the next 6 months.
Conduct detailed ROI analysis on all existing process bottlenecks to prioritize incremental improvements.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation pipeline and governance structure (Innovation Process: none).
Decentralized initiative management leading to inconsistent adoption and resource duplication.
Limited technical foundation for scalable AI/ML solutions required for market defense.
